name: Hindersche
summary: Four-player anticlockwise trick-avoidance game from the Black Forest where high cards are penalized and stolen tricks are allowed.
rules_text: 4 players, 36 cards in French suits, rank A>K>Q>J>10>9>8>7>6 except trump Jack is top (Old Man) and Jack of same colour is second (Little Man). Aces 11, Tens 10, Kings 4, Queens 3, Jacks 2 =140 points. Deal 9 each in 3s anticlockwise, turn last card for trump. Forehand right of dealer leads. If you have led suit you may follow suit OR trump; if not, you may trump or discard. Highest of led suit wins unless trumped. Schleipfen: you may take a trick won by someone else if nobody objects before next lead. First round Vier-Strich: up to 4 deals, most points gets a penalty mark; >=100 points is a march and gives 1 mark to each other player; ties for most have a playoff. Players with zero marks drop out. Second round Butzen: fewest points erases a mark, most receives it to keep 4 marks on slate; with excess marks, lowest scorers erase; with 3 marks, highest adds one. Taking all tricks or >=100 erases 2 marks. Last player left loses.
